acceleration_g.description: peak acceleration of an EA event, magnitude, INSTANTANEOUS

acceleration_threshold_g.description: the EA threshold the event exceeded (`maxAccelerationThrsh`)

asset.description: the vehicle the event was recorded against

category.description: which kind of event it is: harsh braking or harsh acceleration

deceleration_g.description: peak deceleration of an HB event, magnitude, INSTANTANEOUS (never summed)

deceleration_threshold_g.description: the HB threshold the event exceeded (`minDecelerationThrsh`)

device.description: the telematics device that recorded the event

driver.description: the operator attributed to the event

gps.description: the position carried on the event, and by the declared producer edge the geographic area it is attributed to

occurred_at.description: when the harsh braking/acceleration event occurred

raw_attributes.description: the untouched source event payload, including the per-second acceleration/GPS trace the resource description promises

source_system.description: which bound system emitted the row
